method: Every candidate opened and viewed. Category membership is NOT treated as evidence of subject. An image with no decision here is NOT curated and is never admitted by default.
decidedBy: build-lead visual review (single reviewer; NOT two independent reviews)

tiera-footwear-490ae0ba2a.note: Black patent lace-up knee/thigh-high boots on legs, red backdrop. Clear footwear subject, no face.

tiera-footwear-7bab044fbf.reason: Subject is footprints in snow; the boots are a tiny distant object. Also carries a third-party 500px watermark, which is a licensing red flag on a supposedly free file.

tiera-footwear-f0ba5ffd53.reason: Three identifiable people donning hazmat suits. Subject is the people and suits, not footwear, and three faces are clearly visible.

tiera-footwear-f249813dd0.note: Retail ski-boot display wall. Doubles as the store_display stratum and carries visible brand SIGNAGE (Salomon, Rossignol, Lange) — brand text is on the shelf label, not the garment, so brand ground truth stays not_visible. Third-party trademarks visible incidentally.

tiera-skirt-8f16ef5c8e.note: Museum flat-lay of a striped woven skirt. Genuine garment subject. A colour calibration chart is in frame and is tagged as a difficulty, not hidden.

tiera-skirt-d7e0b3f373.reason: A 1940s magazine advertisement — illustration plus body text, not a photograph of a garment. Not a usable identification case.

tiera-top-0b40a58dff.reason: Three identifiable people at an event, faces fully visible. Subject is the people, not a garment.

tiera-top-1144bf2cff.reason: Good market-stall t-shirt display, but a partially identifiable face is in frame and no masked derivative is approved. Re-consider after masking; also carries third-party political imagery.

tiera-top-485911abee.reason: Excellent trade-show t-shirt display, but two identifiable faces in frame. Re-consider after masking.

tiera-outerwear-0b5fd2b653.note: Flat-lay of a historic coat-form garment on white. Clean garment subject, no people. Unusual material is tagged as a difficulty rather than guessed at.

tiera-outerwear-0e07b2e685.reason: Extreme close-up of printed textile pattern. No garment silhouette, no identifiable item — subject is the fabric, not a wearable.

tiera-pants-24e666e3bd.note: Close-packed denim jeans/shorts, cropped. Strong denim material case and a genuine partial-framing case.

curationRule: Any image containing an identifiable face is REJECTED in this pass, because no masked derivative has been produced or approved. Consistent rule, applied even where the image would otherwise be a good case.
